title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, face, chest burst, zigzags, legs, feet, BB)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes: A chibi version of the costume in the Instagram photo: red ball cap with white BB, white goggle face with friendly black eyes, a big hooked white beak with the red mouth showing, red body with the white chest starburst and the white zigzag hem, red wings with white zigzag tips, white legs and big three-toed feet with black claws, on a black round base. Things to check: does it read as our Thunderbird? Beak size and shape, the face patch, cap, chest mark, leg length, and whether 80 mm is the right size. Ideas: a name on the base (BLACK BOB or THUNDERBIRDS), arms raised or waving, a tail.
